Also, there are three points
to note about combos.

Second, it needs the {{prep}} and
{{cooldown}} of every {{part}} in the combo.

Third, if <c:ff00ff>even one {{part}}<c> is destroyed
during {{prep}}, the combo is <c:ff00ff>canceled<c>.

Combos prep slowly, leaving gaps,
so they cancel easily, but...

Master it and it's an attack {{technique}}
that widens your strategy a lot.

Now, use combos to win
this {{robattle}}.
Understood, I'll give it a try.
